title: Close Drizzle Migration (Shim Removal + Naming Residue)

sprint.goal: Finish the Prisma→Drizzle migration in one decisive pass: remove the $executeRawUnsafe/$queryRawUnsafe shim and Bun/Node SQLite branching, delete the PrismaClient type shim, rename Prisma-named test mock helpers to Drizzle naming, and remove the stale OPENAI_API_KEY — so the codebase unambiguously uses Drizzle with no migration residue left.
stories: S1: Audit & catalog all raw-SQL shim call sites (carried over from remove_prisma_shim Phase 1)
S2: Replace $executeRawUnsafe/$queryRawUnsafe with Drizzle-native queries; remove Bun/Node branching
S3: Verify affected routes (stats, system/health, startup repair) against in-memory SQLite
S4: Remove PrismaClient type shim (types/prisma.ts) in favor of DatabaseClient
S5: Rename Prisma-named test mock helpers to Drizzle/Db naming
sprint.demo_notes: Zero grep hits for $executeRawUnsafe/$queryRawUnsafe, PrismaClient, and createPrismaMock/makePrisma in non-archived code; full CI green; tech-debt items marked Resolved.
